property_mix.era: predominantly Victorian and interwar, with post-war council housing
property_mix.notable: Historic industrial town with dense Victorian terracing and significant post-war social housing stock; many properties feature original period locks and sash windows

locksmith_relevant: Victorian terraced housing dominates Darlaston; many retain original rim locks, mortices, and period hardware requiring specialist knowledge.
Post-war council estates feature standardized locks now 50+ years old; high replacement and repair demand from aging stock.
Former industrial area with converted workshops and period commercial properties; many require period-appropriate or reinforced security solutions.
